summary: Candidate 'Multi-Tool Agent Orchestration' is a distinct session_skill addressing multi-tool/multi-agent coordination across frameworks (CrewAI, LangChain, OpenAI, SmolAgents). It differs semantically and functionally from existing skills: not a Maven repository configuration task, not a Flink stream iteration pattern, and not a specific job description workflow. Peer candidates (LLM API tracking, instrumentor lifecycle, job description workflow) are orthogonal instrumentation and domain-specific implementations, not overlapping orchestration capabilities. The candidate has support evidence from Debugging Roadmap and represents a core agent orchestration capability absent from the registry.
